_comment: Release gate (Grok practice 16): mutation testing of the chat envelope, the AI-answer classifier, the phrase rules and the probe. A surviving mutant is a change to the code no test notices. Run: pnpm test:mutation. The command runner is used because @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner 10.0.0 ran no test per mutant under vitest 5 (every mutant 'survived' with 0 tests). The break threshold only rises: 68 is the first measured score (68.21%, 28 Oct; probe.ts 40.7% is the weak spot).
